Sandbox_DownedRP_KnockdownEnable_tooltip: Module for making players go down to a non-combative state when their health drops below a set threshold. Configure at Sandbox_DownedRP - Knockdowns page.
Sandbox_DownedRP_KnockdownThreshold_tool: Health a player must drop under to be knocked down, in percentage.
Sandbox_DownedRP_BleedoutTimer_tooltip: Adds a timer until a guaranteed death. Keeps ticking even if the player disconnects to prevent exploitation.
Sandbox_DownedRP_KnockdownDurationSec_to: How much time a player can spend downed before dying, in seconds.
Sandbox_DownedRP_MoveWhileDowned_tooltip: Whether a downed player is able to crawl or is stuck in place.
Sandbox_DownedRP_KnockdownHoldMode_toolt: On prevents all damage while downed. Off stops the bleeding but leaves you vulnerable to further attacks from zombies and players. Drain takes your health away until death, increasing the bleedout rate if you crawl.
Sandbox_DownedRP_KnockdownHoldHP_tooltip: Health buffer the player gets when downed, in percentage.
Sandbox_DownedRP_DownedPlayerKill_toolti: While downed and not invulnerable, a player can still be hit by other players until finished off.
Sandbox_DownedRP_DownedZombieKill_toolti: While downed and not invulnerable, a player can still be hit by other zombies until finished off. If disabled, zombies will ignore downed players instead.
Sandbox_DownedRP_KnockdownDrainHpPerMin_: Health lost per minute while downed and invulnerability is set to drain.
Sandbox_DownedRP_KnockdownCrawlSpeedPct_: Movement speed while crawling, as a percentage of normal walking speed. Lower is slower.
Sandbox_DownedRP_KnockdownReviveTime_too: The amount of time it takes a player to bring a downed player back up, in milliseconds.
Sandbox_DownedRP_KnockdownReviveHP_toolt: The health a player is set to after being helped from a downed state, in percentage.
Sandbox_DownedRP_KnockdownCounters_toolt: If enabled, adds a 'Knockdown' counter for the amount of times a player has been recently downed. After the limit, the player cannot be helped back up.
Sandbox_DownedRP_KnockdownStrikeLimit_to: Number of knockdowns allowed within the time window before the next one causes instant death. Set to 1 for instant death on second knockdown.
Sandbox_DownedRP_KnockdownHealingMin_too: The time it takes to lose a knockdown from the counter, in minutes.
Sandbox_DownedRP_SelfTreatFirstAidLevel_: Required First Aid level for a downed player to treat their own wounds. -1 = forbidden, 0 = any level, 1-10 = minimum level required.
Sandbox_DownedRP_AssistEnable_tooltip: After a revive, the rescued player follows the rescuer at reduced speed.
Sandbox_DownedRP_AssistFollowDistance_to: Distance in tiles before the rescued player starts pathfinding to the rescuer.
Sandbox_DownedRP_AssistBreakDistance_too: Distance in tiles at which the assisted walk automatically ends.
Sandbox_DownedRP_AssistSpeedModifier_too: Movement speed for both players during assisted walk, as a percentage of normal speed.
